notes: «قال كتب إلى يعلى بن حكيم أني سمعت سليمان بن يسار» — Ayyub's letter is addressed to Ya'la, but the report's content is Ayyub's own hearing from Sulayman, so Ya'la is not a link of this route (a reading choice, not a rule settled by the text)
«رواه سعيد عن يعلى بن حكيم» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«كنا نحاقل الأرض» is Rafi's saying; the Prophet is not in the chain
